key_insight: MorphoStain uses physics-guided AI to separate overlapping Tau and amyloid-β staining in Alzheimer’s neuropathology, not cancer drug discovery.
clinical_relevance: The framework could support neuropathology biomarker analysis, but the abstract does not establish diagnostic utility or clinical readiness.
method: Unsupervised latent diffusion models stain separation on a Beer–Lambert optical-density manifold.
Morphological routing disentangles targets sharing the same chromogen.
Teacher distillation produces a compact 0.12-million-parameter U-Net with uncertainty quantification.
evidence_signal: On 9,908 held-out SEA-AD patches, the authors report 40.56 dB PSNR, 0.9961 SSIM and 140.1 FPS, with significant gains over InverseAE and NMF (both p < 0.001).
watch_item: Identical-spectrum separation is inherently ill-posed; external-cohort validation and confirmation of biological fidelity remain important.
paper_title: MorphoStain: Physics-Guided Latent Diffusion and Morphological Distillation for Multiplex Stain Decomposition in Alzheimer's Neuropathology
